title: Federal Reserve Board - Federal Reserve Board approves final rule requiring the largest, most systemically important U.S. bank holding companies to further strengthen their capital positions
关键词: The Bank of New York Mellon Corporation
主要内容: The Federal Reserve Board approved a final rule requiring the largest, most systemically important U.S. bank holding companies to calculate a risk-based capital surcharge. Eight U.S. firms are expected to be identified as GSIBs: Bank of America Corporation; The Bank of New York Mellon Corporation; Citigroup, Inc.; The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc.; JPMorgan Chase & Co.; Morgan Stanley; State Street Corporation; and Wells Fargo & Company. The rule requires GSIBs to calculate their surcharges under two methods and use the higher of the two surcharges. The first method is based on the framework agreed to by the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision and considers a GS. The surcharges will be phased in beginning on January 1, 2016, becoming fully effective on January 1, 2019.

股票实体.名称: The Bank of New York Mellon Corporation
